_help: Icon libraries offered at intake 0.6b (Abdul, 2026-10-06). The chosen id is saved in status.json > icons.library. All are free, ship as SVG and allow commercial use (license checked 2026-10-06 on the npm package). The workflow fetches the SVGs itself (Iconify API or the npm package, without a color parameter) and builds the Icon component set in Figma; the user does nothing. 'existing' means the project's Figma file or a linked library already has icon components, which are reused.

libraries.name: Lucide
libraries.style: outline, stroke 2 on a 24 grid, round caps
libraries.notes: Web default. Fetch without the color parameter (it fills stroke-only paths); keep fill none and bind the stroke.

libraries.name: SF Symbols style
libraries.license: Apple SF Symbols license (Xcode and SF Symbols app agreement)
libraries.commercial_use: only in designs and apps for Apple platforms; never as a logo or app icon
libraries.style: outline and fill, weights matched to the text (Regular default)
libraries.notes: iOS default. Export the real symbols from the SF Symbols app into vectors, or draw matching glyphs (iOS Main Skill section 5). Not offered for Web or Android.

libraries.name: Material Symbols
libraries.style: Rounded or Outlined, weight 400, grade 0, optical size 24

libraries.name: Phosphor
libraries.style: six weights (Thin, Light, Regular, Bold, Fill, Duotone); use Regular, plus Fill for selected states
libraries.notes: Large set (about 1,500 icons per weight), friendly rounded look.

libraries.name: Tabler
libraries.style: outline, stroke 2 on a 24 grid, plus a smaller filled set
libraries.variants: outline, and filled where it exists
libraries.notes: Largest set (about 5,900 icons); close to Lucide in look, good for dashboards.

libraries.name: Heroicons
libraries.notes: Small set (about 320 icons) by the Tailwind team; a missing icon is drawn in the same style or taken from Lucide and logged in the CHANGELOG.

libraries.name: Remix Icon
libraries.license: Remix Icon License v1.0 (npm says Apache-2.0)
libraries.commercial_use: yes inside apps, websites and design systems; never sold as a standalone icon pack, used to make a competing icon set, or used as a logo or app icon
libraries.style: line and fill pairs on a 24 grid
libraries.notes: About 3,000 icons, every icon has a line and a fill version.
